items.title: Germaine Bazzle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: I can’t imagine Bach as a jazz piece... I’m just asking you have you really listened to it... Bach swings.

ctx.x: I love them. I love them. I love them. And I tried to get a group of people, musicians, especially vocal music teachers, I tried to get a group of them together. Because I wanted to do Swingle Singers. And more than one told me that they didn’t think that they could do that. And I said, “Why not?” I can’t imagine Bach as a jazz piece. I said, “Back off.” Have you really listened? Have you really played I mean just a simple two part invention? Have you really played it, have you really listened to all that’s going…
Um hum. You’re doing some kind of polyphony there.
